```yaml
name: Test Meshery Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Sistent
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Sistent dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Sistent
        run: npm run build

      - name: Pack Sistent
        id: pack
        run: |
          tarball=$(npm pack)
          echo "tarball=$tarball" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Verify tarball exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball }}" ]; then
            echo "Tarball ${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball }} not found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Clone Meshery UI
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/meshery/meshery.git meshery
          cd meshery
          git checkout main

      - name: Install Sistent into Meshery UI
        env:
          TARBALL: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball }}
        run: |
          cd meshery
          npm ci
          npm install "../$TARBALL"
          if ! grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json > /dev/null; then
            echo "No test script found in Meshery UI package.json"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build Meshery UI
        run: |
          cd meshery
          npm run build

      - name: Run Meshery UI tests
        id: test
        run: |
          cd meshery
          npm test
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Report results
        env:
          TEST_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.test.outcome }}
        run: |
          echo "## Meshery UI Integration Test Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          if [ "$TEST_OUTCOME" == "success" ]; then
            echo "✅ Meshery UI tests passed." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          else
            echo "❌ Meshery UI tests failed." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi
```
